readinessExpectation.reason: All requested definitions, relationships, multiplicities, property type/value, scope exclusions, and provenance authorities are explicit with no assumption or unresolved uncertainty.

requiredMeaning.requirement: One Cold Room Climate Controller Block is present as the structural whole.
One Temperature Probe Block is present.
One Cooling Relay Block is present.
Temperature Probe is the part/source and controller the whole/target; role probes; multiplicity 2..8.
Cooling Relay is the part/source and controller the whole/target; role coolingRelays; multiplicity 1..4.
Controller exposes sampleIntervalSeconds as Integer, multiplicity 1, default value 30.
Probe-relay association preserves relay end 1 and probe end 1..* with existing Block endpoints.
